verdict.rationale: Eqvista documents its own export paths: downloadable extended and summary cap table reports, and a downloadable PDF of round-modeling analysis. Nothing shows these exports are in open, machine-readable formats or cover all account data. The migration docs (Pulley, Carta, spreadsheet import) describe moving data into Eqvista, not out, so they earn no credit. Missing for 10: documented open-format export (e.g. CSV/JSON/XLSX) of the full dataset (stakeholders, transactions, documents, data room, board records), any bulk or API export, a documented offboarding/exit path, and independent confirmation that exports are complete.
